summary: The drawing could not be used to make or inspect the part. It is in third-angle projection when the blueprint requires first-angle, Pocket1 and the Pin hole are undimensioned, the hole pattern is not located from datum A, and the title block, tolerances, GD&T, finish and notes are missing.

flags.title: Third-angle projection used; blueprint requires first-angle
flags.evidence: snapshot drawings[0].sheet.projection = 'third angle'; blueprint §6 'Drawing: ISO 128, first-angle projection'
flags.recommendation: Change the sheet projection to first angle and re-check that the front and top views are in the first-angle layout. Add the first-angle symbol to the title block.

suggested_change.detail: set sheet projection to first angle; re-place the top view below the front view; add the first-angle symbol in the title block

flags.title: Pocket1 and Pin hole have no dimension or callout
flags.evidence: drawings[0].problems: uncovered_feature 'Pocket1 has no dimension or callout' and 'Pin hole has no dimension or callout'. The model has D1@Pocket1 = 30, D2@Pocket1 = 6, D1@Pin hole = 3, D2@Pin hole = 36, and none are on the drawing. The only annotations are RD1 (125), RD2 (10) and RD3 (hole callout).
flags.recommendation: Dimension Pocket1 (size, depth, position from datum A and the end faces, corner radius). Call out the Pin hole (Ø3, depth 36, position) in a view that shows its axis (+x).

suggested_change.detail: insert model dimensions D1@Pocket1, D2@Pocket1, D1@Pin hole and D2@Pin hole in the top view, and add a Ø3 x 36 callout on the Pin hole in a view that shows its x axis

flags.title: Only front and top views; no side view or section for the hidden features
flags.evidence: drawings[0].views = [front, top]. The Pin hole axis is [1,0,0] and starts on the x = 0 face, and Pocket1 depth cannot be read from either view. The model has setup_directions -x and +y, which no view shows. No section view exists.
flags.recommendation: Add a left side view and a section through Pocket1 and the Pin hole. Add an isometric view for orientation if needed.

suggested_change.detail: add a projected left view (-x) and a section A-A through Pocket1 and Pin hole

flags.title: M8 hole pattern is not located from datum A
flags.evidence: The only annotations are two overall dimensions and RD3 (4X Ø8.4 THRU / ⌴ Ø15 ↧ 6). No dimension locates the 80 x 40 pattern (holes model centre [20,10,5], pattern '80 x 40 rectangle', INT-001) or the 30 mm and 36 mm Pocket1 and Pin hole positions.
flags.recommendation: Dimension the 80 x 40 pattern, its offsets from the part edges and datum A, as functional dimensions taken from the datum rather than chained.

suggested_change.detail: add the 80 and 40 pattern dimensions plus the edge offsets (20 and 10 from the model) to the 4X hole callout RD3 in the top view, with datum A as the origin

flags.title: Title block incomplete
flags.evidence: title_block: part_no = null, general_tolerance = null, drawn_by = null. The date, revision, units and projection symbol are not present. Material '6061 Alloy' and weight '0.17 kg' match the model (parts[0].material, mass_kg 0.168), and scale 1:1 is on the sheet.
flags.recommendation: Fill in the part number, the general tolerance 'ISO 2768-mK', units (mm), author, date, revision and projection symbol.

suggested_change.detail: set title block: general_tolerance 'ISO 2768-mK', part_no, drawn_by, date, revision, units mm

flags.title: No datums or GD&T on the wall-mount interface
flags.evidence: INT-001 defines datum A as the back face (-z) and a 4x M8 pattern on 80 x 40. The drawing's annotations contain no datum feature symbol or geometric tolerance.
flags.recommendation: Add datum A on the back face, flatness on A, and position of the 4x Ø8.4 pattern relative to A (and a secondary datum on an edge). The tolerance values need the engineer's decision.

suggested_change.detail: add_symbol datum A on the back face (-z); add gtol flatness on A; add gtol position on hole:CBORE for M8 referencing A and a secondary edge datum

flags.title: No tolerances or fits on any dimension
flags.evidence: All dimensions have tolerance = null (snapshot parts[0].dimensions) and the drawing has no tolerance notes. The Ø3 x 36 Pin hole is likely a functional (pin) hole.
flags.recommendation: The engineer should state whether the Pin hole needs a fit (for example H7) and whether the M8 clearance holes follow ISO 2768-mK or need tighter tolerances.

suggested_change.detail: decide the fit for the Ø3 Pin hole and the tolerance on the 80 x 40 pattern

flags.title: No surface finish requirement
flags.evidence: The drawing has no Ra symbols or general finish note. Datum A (the mounting face) is a functional face.
flags.recommendation: Add a general finish note (for example Ra 3.2) and a tighter Ra on the mounting face A. The values need the engineer's decision.

suggested_change.detail: choose the general Ra and the Ra of the mounting face

flags.title: No general notes for edge break, deburr, coating or thread standard
flags.evidence: The drawing has no note annotations. The blueprint names ISO 965 6H threads (§6), and the material is EN AW-6082-T6.
flags.recommendation: Add notes: break sharp edges 0.3, deburr, and surface treatment (for example anodize) if required. Add a thread note per ISO 965 6H if the pin hole is threaded.

suggested_change.detail: add general notes: 'BREAK SHARP EDGES 0.3 MAX', 'DEBURR ALL EDGES'; add a surface treatment note if required
